The '''UR-2212-GR system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to a [[blue]] [[Unidentified gas giant (UR-2212-GR system)|gas giant]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a [[frozen moon]]. On the moon was a secret [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Imperial research facility|research facility]] that was home to a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] experiment. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], a misjump caused the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] to [[Time travel/Legends|travel]] through [[Time/Legends|time]] to [[41 ABY]]. It came out of its failed [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] tunnel in this system, where [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] and [[Scavenger/Legends|salvagers]] [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]] had also arrived, following a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of Korr's.

==Behind the scenes==
The UR-2212-GR system was established, albeit unnamed, in the [[2010]] novel ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].
